component.name: Rinflow
component.summary: Use one mouse and keyboard across your computers
用一套键鼠操作你的所有电脑

description.p: Move the pointer off the edge of this screen and it appears on the computer next to it: a Mac, a Windows PC, another Linux machine or a Steam Deck. The keyboard follows. Every connection is encrypted and new devices pair with a six-digit code.
把指针推出屏幕边缘，它就出现在旁边那台电脑上：Mac、Windows、另一台 Linux 或 Steam Deck，键盘随之切换。所有连接都加密，新设备用六位配对码配对。
On GNOME and KDE the desktop asks once whether Rinflow may capture and play input. In Steam Deck's Gaming Mode this device can be controlled by others.
First Linux release: GNOME and KDE on Wayland through the input portals, Steam Deck Gaming Mode as a controlled device.
